findings.detail: Unmodified V41 decoder assumes an object ID occurs in only one pack; case-000 native source has duplicate object representations across retained packs. Initial audit attempt failed unique_object:025fda95c7c57fa44aea8b9828c833f35ff275e9. Decoder updated in audit directory only to validate every duplicate representation for identical raw kind/body and object identity. This is not a target or frozen-experiment modification.

V41 source audit assumed only regular tracked modes. V42 case-002 docs/index.md is a symlink; raw filesystem tree equality passed before the stricter obsolete regular-mode assertion failed. Audit-only decoder/archive comparison updated to validate symlink target bytes and mode 120000. Frozen inputs unchanged.

After raw symlink bytes/mode/full-tree equality passed, V41-style manifest hash differed from V42 recorded typed source identity because V42 also binds link target, resolved_path and target-content sha256. Audit-only independent manifest reconstruction now includes those typed fields after separately checking the observed internal regular-file target. Frozen inputs unchanged.

Main audit initially assumed admission-v3.json == admission-v42.json == report.setup. All six equality checks failed. Complete first check report and exact first script retained under audit-helper-attempts. Static wrapper inspection established V42 adds only versioned schema and typed_source_operation source digests. The corrected audit independently verifies that exact wrapper over unchanged V3 receipt; all 1,254 checks then pass. No frozen input or experiment was changed.
